security.reason: BP-006 is presentation only: React components, a token module and CSS. It adds no request path, authentication, SQL or cookie handling, so no REQUIRED CON-51x control has anything to govern. CON-517 is nonetheless honoured: dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, outerHTML and insertAdjacentHTML appear nowhere in backoffice/src. No package was added or upgraded; the guard scripts use node:fs and Intl only.

baseline.detail: No server headers; backoffice is a static SPA.
No DTOs or server-side input validation added.
React automatic escaping relied upon; no raw-HTML injection API anywhere in src/, verified by grep.
No cookies, CORS or state-changing routes touched.

performance.reason: NFR-003 was measured and passes, but NFR-004 (RTL), NFR-005 (keyboard), NFR-006 (375 px) and NFR-009 (console-error-free render) need a running app and a browser, which this review did not drive. No /sdrive:performance report exists for the feature.
performance.method: Contrast computed with the WCAG 2.x relative-luminance formula over every token pair the components render; 10% tints resolved by compositing the tint over the page background before measuring.
